column3: Close to the Hebrew; זַמְּרוּ־ לוֹ (“make music”) is rendered “sing psalms,” and “tell of” “Talk of.”
Close to the Hebrew; הִתְהַלְלוּ (“boast”) is rendered “Glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “men of number” is rendered “few in number.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every staff of bread” is rendered “all the provision of bread.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his soul came into iron” is rendered “He was laid in irons.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his word came” is rendered “his word came to pass.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיֶּפֶר (“made fruitful”) is rendered “He increased.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו (“to deal deceitfully”) is rendered “To deal craftily.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the Hebrew “they did not rebel,” where the Septuagint reads “they rebelled.”
